shortDescription: Consul ACL token management for v1.5.0

options.name: accessor_id
options.description: A UUID for accessing the token pair.

options.name: address
options.description: The url to connect to consul. Using '<schema>//<domain>:<port>'. For a unix domain socket, give 'unix:' with literal location. Example: 'unix:///var/run/consul/http.sock'.

options.name: description
options.description: A readable short description of the token.

options.name: expiration_time
options.description: The amount of time till the token expires.

options.name: expiration_ttl
options.description: Sets expiration_time to creation time + expiration_ttl value.

options.name: local
options.description: Whether the token is only locally available in the current datacenter or to all datacenters defined.

options.name: management_token
options.description: A token with permissions to create or modify the token.

options.name: policies
options.description: A list of PolicyLink (a map with ID or Name of the token). {'See the consul API for examples of a PolicyLink': 'https://www.consul.io/api/acl/roles.html#policies'}

options.name: roles
options.description: A list of RoleLink (a map with ID or Name of the role). {'See the consul API for examples of a RoleLink': 'https://www.consul.io/api/acl/tokens.html#roles'}

options.name: secret_id
options.description: A UUID for making requests to consul for the token pair.

options.name: service_identities
options.description: A list of services to filter the token. The list contains only ServiceIdenty (a map with ServiceName for the service). {'See the Consul API for example of a ServiceIdentity': 'https://www.consul.io/api/acl/roles.html#serviceidentities'}

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the token should be present or absent from consul
